$comment: Style pack: Info-graphics video essay. Learned from the user's reference Short 'Disney vs Midjourney' (YouTube Shorts fZIXlBGaIMs, 88 s, read for technique only, nothing copied). Colours were sampled from its frames: dark ground #191919, cream #fbf3e1, light grey #f5f5f5, accent orange about #e4722a. orange-deep is the text shade on light grounds (the sampled orange is about 2.7:1 on cream, lesson 13az). Italic accents are a synthesized oblique of Inter (a grotesk italic is close to an oblique; no italic cut is bundled). Workflow and judgment: .claude/skills/skill-info-graphics/SKILL.md.
label: Info-graphics Essay
use: Voice-led video essays and explainers: a new visual every sentence, built from kinetic type with one orange word, equations, stairs and pyramids, social posts, prompt bars with a cursor, orbits, counters, photo plates and collages, over dark, cream or light-grey grounds, with a one-word caption chip.

display.$note: bundled; stack lines, equation terms, numbers

body.$note: bundled; post text, prompt text, labels

heavy.$note: bundled; the one shouted word (*word* in a stack with heavy=true)

mono.$note: bundled; code and prompt text when mono=true

captions.$note: one spoken word at a time on a small black chip, low centre (y about 1440); no pop, no colour change. The chip is the only caption.

sfx.$note: Essay beds are voice plus a quiet music bed. Sounds mark causal events only: a scene swipe, a click, a pop when an object lands, a tick per step, typing. Start low; voices at -14 LUFS / -3.6 dBTP (lesson 13bc).
